dsn.description: A URL, oracle://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/SERVICE, naming the pluggable database's service, such as FREEPDB1; the port is 1521 if it's left empty, as HOST:/SERVICE. The user's own schema holds the destination's staging, fence and markers, and is where tables go when the pipeline names no namespace. Options go in its query: TLS with ?SSL=true, verifying the server's certificate unless SSL VERIFY=false, and a wallet with WALLET=/path/to/wallet; CONNECTION TIMEOUT=SECONDS bounds a connection's setup.
dsn.title: Connection URL
